---
name: Community proposal
about: Suggest a bounded, source-backed improvement without exposing sensitive details
title: "community: "
---

## Boundary confirmation

- [ ] This is a non-sensitive, educational proposal. It does not contain credentials, personal data, live targets, exploit instructions for uninvolved systems, or a private security report.
- [ ] I understand that an issue or web proposal is **not canonical knowledge** and cannot directly edit Markdown/YAML, generated artifacts, labs, or Git history.
- [ ] I will use the private reporting path in `SECURITY.md` instead if this concerns a security vulnerability or accidental secret.

## Controlled proposal type

Choose one: tool, vulnerability, concept, technique, technology, defensive control, safe lab, learning path, relationship, source, verification correction, content correction, or broken link.

## Summary and learner value

Explain the proposed improvement in bounded plain text. Describe why it is useful for an authorized, defensive learning audience.

## Sources and generated entities

List authoritative HTTPS sources and, where relevant, existing generated entity IDs. State uncertainty or possible duplicates plainly.

## Safety and review considerations

Explain authorization boundaries, defensive framing, relationship impact, validation to run, and any conflict of interest. Do not attach executable payloads, target details, or sensitive evidence.
